name: guard_bench_v1
purpose: Labelled tool calls for the active-memory stand (ledger J6): past mistakes as notes, tool calls that repeat them (positives) and tool calls that do not (negatives, some sharing the identifiers) - so a guard's catch rate and false-alarm rate can be read at a matched false-positive rate against the cheap rivals: a linter, prompt recall, a cold-start pack.
provenance: Written by hand in research/gen_guard_bench.py; generic pitfalls follow the engine's anti-pattern rules and the live-validation tasks, project pitfalls are this repository's own recorded mistakes, restated as a synthetic project's.
limitations: Single-author, synthetic, and small: it supports a precision/recall reading at a matched false-positive rate, not a population estimate.
Positives are the author's idea of a repeat; a real agent's repeat may be phrased in a way no row here anticipates - the stand measures the rows, not the world.
The linter column is scored in the linter's favour, as research/cheap_baselines_rules.json does.

mistakes.title: SQL built by f-string
mistakes.desc: the user id was interpolated into the query with an f-string and execute() ran it; a crafted id read another user's rows
mistakes.prevention: pass parameters to execute(), never build SQL text from variables

linter_or_test.by: bandit S608 / ruff S608 (hardcoded SQL expression)

mistakes.title: SQL built by percent formatting
mistakes.desc: a query string was built with % formatting before execute()
mistakes.prevention: use the driver's parameter binding; the query text must not contain the value

mistakes.title: money kept as float
mistakes.desc: prices were parsed with float() and a sum came out a cent short
mistakes.prevention: use Decimal for money; never float()

linter_or_test.by: no standard linter models the domain of a float

mistakes.title: response.json() without checking the status
mistakes.desc: a 500 page was parsed as JSON and the traceback pointed at the parser, not the server
mistakes.prevention: check response.ok or raise_for_status() before .json()

linter_or_test.by: no linter models the order of status check and parse

mistakes.title: bare except swallowed a KeyboardInterrupt
mistakes.desc: a bare except: hid the real error and ate Ctrl-C
mistakes.prevention: catch the specific exception; never a bare except:

mistakes.title: mutable default argument shared across calls
mistakes.desc: a list default accumulated values between calls
mistakes.prevention: default to None and create the list inside the function

mistakes.title: list mutated while iterating over it
mistakes.desc: items were removed from the list inside a for loop over the same list and every other one was skipped
mistakes.prevention: iterate over a copy or build a new list

mistakes.title: eval() on user input
mistakes.desc: a filter expression from the request went through eval()
mistakes.prevention: never eval() dynamic input; parse it or use ast.literal_eval for literals

mistakes.title: subprocess with shell=True and a string command
mistakes.desc: a filename with a semicolon ran a second command
mistakes.prevention: pass a list and never shell=True

mistakes.title: == None instead of is None
mistakes.desc: an object with a custom __eq__ compared equal to None
mistakes.prevention: compare with is None / is not None

mistakes.title: type(x) == comparison instead of isinstance
mistakes.desc: a subclass failed the type check
mistakes.prevention: use isinstance()

mistakes.title: os.system ran a shell string
mistakes.desc: an argument with spaces broke the command and a quote injection was possible
mistakes.prevention: subprocess.run with a list

mistakes.title: pickle.load on downloaded data
mistakes.desc: a cache file from a network share was unpickled
mistakes.prevention: json for data; pickle only for data you wrote yourself in the same process family

mistakes.title: yaml.load without a safe loader
mistakes.desc: a config file constructed arbitrary objects
mistakes.prevention: yaml.safe_load

mistakes.title: TLS verification disabled
mistakes.desc: verify=False was left in a client after a local test
mistakes.prevention: never verify=False outside a marked test fixture

mistakes.title: md5 for a password hash
mistakes.desc: passwords were hashed with md5
mistakes.prevention: a KDF (bcrypt/argon2/scrypt); md5 and sha1 only for non-security checksums

mistakes.title: open() without a context manager
mistakes.desc: a file handle leaked when an exception was raised before close()
mistakes.prevention: with open(...) as f

mistakes.title: division by len() with no empty guard
mistakes.desc: average() raised ZeroDivisionError on an empty list
mistakes.prevention: handle the empty case before dividing by len()

linter_or_test.by: no linter models an unguarded divide by len()

mistakes.title: requests call without a timeout
mistakes.desc: a hung upstream blocked the worker forever
mistakes.prevention: always pass timeout= to requests

mistakes.title: exec() on a string from the outside
mistakes.desc: a plugin string was exec()'d
mistakes.prevention: never exec() dynamic input

mistakes.title: test code wrote to the owner's live memory store
mistakes.desc: a test resolved the vault to D:/Obsidian/Claude_Memory and wrote fixtures into it
mistakes.prevention: tests and research scripts run inside sandbox_guard.isolate(); the live store path never appears in test code

linter_or_test.by: tools/check_sandbox.py - a project-local lint that fails the build when a script reaches the store without a sandbox

mistakes.title: render_chart(rows) raised on an empty list
mistakes.desc: render_chart was called on an empty result set and crashed the report
mistakes.prevention: guard with `if rows:` before render_chart(rows)

linter_or_test.by: a project API contract no linter knows

mistakes.title: set_timeout got seconds, not milliseconds
mistakes.desc: set_timeout(5) meant five milliseconds and every call timed out
mistakes.prevention: set_timeout takes milliseconds: pass seconds * 1000

linter_or_test.by: a unit convention no linter knows

mistakes.title: connect() before authenticate() hangs
mistakes.desc: the client hung because connect() was called before authenticate()
mistakes.prevention: call client.authenticate() before client.connect()

linter_or_test.by: a call-order contract no linter knows

mistakes.title: acquire_lock without release in finally
mistakes.desc: an exception between acquire_lock() and release_lock() left the vault locked
mistakes.prevention: release_lock() in a finally block, or use the context manager

linter_or_test.by: resource pairing across a try is not a linter rule

mistakes.title: git push --force rewrote a shared branch
mistakes.desc: a force push dropped a collaborator's commits
mistakes.prevention: never git push --force; --force-with-lease only on your own branch, and never on master

linter_or_test.by: no linter reads shell commands for git flags

mistakes.title: pip install into the global interpreter
mistakes.desc: a competitor package was installed into the system Python and broke the hook's imports
mistakes.prevention: install into the polygon venv: <venv>/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install

mistakes.title: ollama pull on the owner's daemon
mistakes.desc: a model was pulled without asking; the owner's Ollama is not the project's
mistakes.prevention: never ollama pull / rm / stop; use the models that are already listed

mistakes.title: the secrets file was printed
mistakes.desc: cat .secrets.env put an API key into the transcript
mistakes.prevention: never read, print or commit .secrets.env or twin_calibration.json

linter_or_test.by: a secret scanner on the transcript would flag the key; gitleaks on the commit

mistakes.title: a debug print on the hook's hot path
mistakes.desc: a print() in memory_hook.py landed in the hook's stdout, which the agent parses as JSON
mistakes.prevention: the hook prints only the payload JSON; log() goes to stderr and the log file

linter_or_test.by: prints are legal Python; the constraint is this file's protocol

mistakes.title: time.sleep on the hook's hot path
mistakes.desc: a sleep in the PreToolUse path added a visible pause before every edit
mistakes.prevention: never block the hook; retry in the detached catch-up process

mistakes.title: session text capped at 2000 chars before embedding
mistakes.desc: our arm embedded the first 2000 characters of each session while the competitors embedded the whole one
mistakes.prevention: embed whole sessions; the cap is the embedder's context, handled by halving on HTTP 400

mistakes.title: training left on the CPU
mistakes.desc: device was hard-coded to cpu and a run took twelve hours instead of twenty minutes
mistakes.prevention: torch.device('cuda') on this machine; fall back only behind torch.cuda.is_available()

linter_or_test.by: no linter knows the machine has a GPU

mistakes.title: naive datetime.now() mixed with aware timestamps
mistakes.desc: arithmetic between a naive datetime.now() and an aware parsed timestamp raised TypeError
mistakes.prevention: datetime.now().astimezone() everywhere a timestamp may be compared

linter_or_test.by: naivety of a datetime is not a linter rule

mistakes.title: json.dumps escaped Cyrillic into \u sequences
mistakes.desc: a Russian note was written as \u041f... and Obsidian showed escapes
mistakes.prevention: json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False) for anything a person reads

linter_or_test.by: a default argument is not a linter rule

mistakes.title: git add -A swept a cache file into the commit
mistakes.desc: a generated cache landed in the repository with git add -A
mistakes.prevention: add files by name; never git add -A or git add . in this repository

mistakes.title: rm -rf on the results directory
mistakes.desc: committed artifacts were deleted to 'start clean' and the register lost its raw files
mistakes.prevention: never delete research/results; a re-measure overwrites one artifact at a time

mistakes.title: an API key literal in source
mistakes.desc: a key was pasted into a script and committed
mistakes.prevention: read keys from the environment; never a literal

mistakes.title: a token was printed to the console
mistakes.desc: print(token) put the token into the session transcript, which the memory then read
mistakes.prevention: never print a key or token; print its presence or length

linter_or_test.by: what a variable holds is not a linter's business

mistakes.title: open() without encoding on Windows
mistakes.desc: a UTF-8 note was read with the cp1251 default and every Cyrillic letter broke
mistakes.prevention: open(path, encoding='utf-8') for every text file

linter_or_test.by: ruff has no default-encoding rule enabled here

mistakes.title: taskkill /PID under Git Bash
mistakes.desc: Git Bash rewrote /PID into a path and taskkill printed usage instead of killing
mistakes.prevention: use PowerShell Stop-Process from Git Bash, or taskkill //PID

mistakes.title: cd inside a compound command
mistakes.desc: a cd in a compound command triggered a permission prompt and the next command ran elsewhere
mistakes.prevention: use absolute paths or git -C; never cd && in the tool's shell

mistakes.title: a long sleep in the foreground shell
mistakes.desc: sleep 300 blocked the tool call and hit the timeout
mistakes.prevention: never sleep in the foreground; poll with a background waiter or a Monitor

mistakes.title: a test pinned NEVERTWICE_HOME alone
mistakes.desc: the test pinned NEVERTWICE_HOME but an exported NEVERTWICE_VAULT still won and the live store was written
mistakes.prevention: pin both variables, or call sandbox_guard.isolate(), which does

linter_or_test.by: tools/check_sandbox.py flags a file naming NEVERTWICE_HOME without NEVERTWICE_VAULT

mistakes.title: a commit landed on master
mistakes.desc: work was committed straight to master instead of the working branch
mistakes.prevention: never commit to master; work on invariants/v3 or a feature branch

mistakes.title: the installed hook copy was edited by hand
mistakes.desc: a file under ~/.claude/scripts was edited directly and the repository drifted from what runs
mistakes.prevention: edit the repository; sync with tools/sync_install.py --apply and only with permission

linter_or_test.by: no linter knows which copy is canonical
